blocks.prompt: 7 Find the binomial coefficient \(\left({}^{8}C_{3}\right)\) using Pascal's triangle.
blocks.explanation:
Pascal's triangle binomial coefficients ki ek tayyar list hai: row \(n\) mein \({}^nC_0, {}^nC_1, \dots, {}^nC_n\) hote hain.
Find kya karna hai? \({}^{8}C_{3}\), yani row 8 ka woh number jo position 3 par hai.
Rule kaunsa? Pascal's rule: har andar wala number upar ke do numbers ka jama hota hai.
Plan: row 0 se row 8 tak triangle banayein aur position 0 se ginti kar ke position 3 parhein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \({}^{8}C_{3}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki value Pascal's triangle se.
Tareeqa: Har row ke dono kinaron par 1 hota hai; andar ka har number us ke bilkul upar wale do numbers ka jama hota hai. Yeh Pascal's rule \({}^{n}C_{r} = {}^{n-1}C_{r-1} + {}^{n-1}C_{r}\) hai. Is tarah factorial ke bagair coefficients mil jate hain.

Row 0 se row 4
\[1\]
\[1\quad 1\]
\[1\quad 2\quad 1\]
\[1\quad 3\quad 3\quad 1\]
\[1\quad 4\quad 6\quad 4\quad 1\]
Kyun: Misaal: row 4 mein \(6 = 3 + 3\) aur \(4 = 1 + 3\). Har row pichli row se ek number lambi hoti hai.

Row 5 se row 7
\[1\ \ 5\ \ 10\ \ 10\ \ 5\ \ 1\]
\[1\ \ 6\ \ 15\ \ 20\ \ 15\ \ 6\ \ 1\]
\[1\ \ 7\ \ 21\ \ 35\ \ 35\ \ 21\ \ 7\ \ 1\]
Kyun: Wohi rule: \(20 = 10 + 10\), \(35 = 15 + 20\). Har row ulti seedhi ek jaisi (symmetric) hoti hai, yeh bhi apne hisaab ko check karne ka achha tareeqa hai.

Position 3 parhein
\[{}^{8}C_0 = 1,\ {}^{8}C_1 = 8\]
\[{}^{8}C_2 = 28,\ {}^{8}C_3 = 56\]
Kyun: Positions 0 se gini jati hain, is liye row 8 ka chautha number \({}^{8}C_{3}\) hai.
Dhyan dein: Positions 1 se ginna aam ghalti hai; tab aap 28 parh lenge jo \({}^{8}C_2\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{8}C_3 = \dfrac{8!}{3!\,5!} = \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{336}{6} = 56\]
Kyun: Factorial wala formula bhi wohi 56 deta hai, to dono tareeqe ek doosre ki tasdeeq karte hain.
